query: A matrix over a field has a rank factorization with independent columns and rows

items.name: LinearIndependent.rank_matrix
items.type:
∀ {m : Type um} {n : Type un} {R : Type uR} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Field R] [inst_2 : Fintype m]
  {M : Matrix m n R}, LinearIndependent R M.row → M.rank = Fintype.card m

items.name: Matrix.rank_of_isUnit
items.type:
∀ {n : Type un} {R : Type uR} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_3 : DecidableEq n]
  (A : Matrix n n R), IsUnit A → A.rank = Fintype.card n

items.name: Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row
items.type:
∀ {m : Type um} {n : Type un} {R : Type uR} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Field R] [Finite m] (A : Matrix m n R),
  A.rank = Module.finrank R ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range A.row))

items.name: Matrix.rank_unit
items.type:
∀ {n : Type un} {R : Type uR} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_3 : DecidableEq n]
  (A : (Matrix n n R)ˣ), (↑A).rank = Fintype.card n

items.name: rank_matrix_module
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] [StrongRankCondition R]
  [Module.Free R M] (m : Type w) (n : Type w') [Finite m] [Finite n],
  Module.rank R (Matrix m n M) =
    Cardinal.lift.{max v w', w} (Cardinal.mk m) * Cardinal.lift.{max v w, w'} (Cardinal.mk n) *
      Cardinal.lift.{max w w', v} (Module.rank R M)
